chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام about a man who stands alone in the row.
He عليه السلام said: “There is no problem; indeed, the row appears one person after another.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal problem

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to stand alone in a row during congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about congregational salat (prayer): there is no issue if a person stands alone in a row. The Imam عليه السلام explains that a row naturally begins with one person and is completed gradually, one after another.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1147 - Musa ibn Bakr asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a man who stands alone in a row during prayer.
Imam (as) said: "There is no problem ; indeed, the row is formed one person at a time."
